# Managed IT Force, LLC

Managed IT Force, LLC is a IT Services and IT Consulting company. Managed IT Force is a company that offers managed IT services and IT support for small businesses in Pittsburgh Area. They provide outsourcing, consulting, remote monitoring, vendor management, co-managed services, vmware, 24/7 help desk, Microsoft hyper-v, desktop monitoring and management, infrastructure support services, security services, network security, and unified threat solutions. Managed IT Force, LLC employs 6 people, founded in 2016. Headquartered in Cranberry Township, Pennsylvania, United States, with an office in Cranberry Twp.

## About

Managed IT Force provides structured IT management for locally owned manufacturing and engineering firms that depend on technology every day—but don’t want technology problems running the business.

Our clients are owners and leadership teams who value continuity, accountability, and predictability. They rely on us to keep systems stable, production moving, and risk controlled without constant escalation or last‑minute surprises.

We specialize in environments where downtime, security incidents, and unclear ownership are not acceptable. That means disciplined onboarding, standardized environments, proactive oversight, and a single point of accountability when something needs to be resolved.

Our approach is intentionally conservative: fewer unsupported changes, fewer reactive emergencies, and fewer decisions pushed back onto the owner. Instead, we focus on reliability, documented standards, and long‑term risk reduction.

Managed IT Force works best with organizations that want IT to be professionally handled—not constantly discussed—so leadership can stay focused on operations, growth, and customers.

# Network One

Network One is a IT Services and IT Consulting company. Network One provides cloud computing solutions and managed IT services to connect offices and work from home. They offer services such as fiber surveillance, networks, security, disaster recovery, data centers, hardware as a service, and voice. Network One employs 11 people (-8.3% YoY, -1 person), founded in 2004. Headquartered in Medford, Oregon, United States, with an office in Yreka.

At Network One, we extend our state-of-the art IT infrastructure to your location through a robust and ISP-neutral fiber network that spans California and Oregon. Connect all your offices or work from home knowing that your infrastructure is secure in one of our three data centers.
